summary: Completed live desktop and mobile UI verification for The Vision Hive marketing site. Core navigation, CTAs, service interaction, marquee hover pause, contact validation/success, mobile menu, and overflow checks passed.

issues: Mobile menu toggle does not expose aria-expanded state; service accordion rows do not expose aria-expanded or expanded/collapsed semantics for assistive technology.

action_items: Add aria-expanded and suitable aria-controls/state semantics to the mobile menu toggle and expandable service rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact submission is intentionally frontend-only and MOCKED; no backend contact API or persistence is connected.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no backend integration requested by implementation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile core flows were exercised against the public preview URL. Recheck accessibility state attributes after fixes; contact form remains MOCKED frontend-only behavior.
rca of the issue: The menu and service expansion are visually stateful React controls, but their rendered buttons do not communicate state through ARIA attributes, reducing screen-reader discoverability despite visible keyboard focus styling.
